var kDefaultHighWaterMark = 65536, kDefaultMaxPendingDatagrams = 128;
function configureOutbound(handle, stream, body) {
  if (body === null) {
    handle.initStreamingSource(), handle.endWrite();
    return;
  if (isPromise(body)) {
    PromisePrototypeThen(body, (resolved) => configureOutbound(handle, stream, resolved), (err) => {
      if (!stream.destroyed)
        stream.destroy(err);
    });
    return;
  if (typeof body === "string") {
    handle.attachSource(validateBody(Buffer.from(body, "utf8")));
    return;
  if (FileHandle.isFileHandle(body)) {
    if (body[kFileLocked])
      throw @makeErrorWithCode(129, "FileHandle is locked");
    body[kFileLocked] = !0, consumeAsyncSource(handle, stream, body.createReadStream());
    return;
  if (isBlob(body)) {
    consumeAsyncSource(handle, stream, body.stream());
    return;
  if (isArrayBuffer(body) || isSharedArrayBuffer(body) || isArrayBufferView(body)) {
    handle.attachSource(validateBody(body));
    return;
  if (isAsyncIterable(body)) {
    consumeAsyncSource(handle, stream, body);
    return;
  if (isSyncIterable(body)) {
    consumeSyncSource(handle, stream, body);
    return;
  throw @makeErrorWithCode(112, "body", [
    "string",
    "ArrayBuffer",
    "SharedArrayBuffer",
    "TypedArray",
    "Blob",
    "Iterable",
    "AsyncIterable",
    "Promise",
    "null"
  ], body);
function initStreamingBackpressure(stream) {
  let state = getQuicStreamState(stream);
  if (state.highWaterMark === 0)
    state.highWaterMark = kDefaultHighWaterMark;
  if (state.writeDesiredSize === 0)
    state.writeDesiredSize = state.highWaterMark;
function waitForDrain(stream) {
  let { promise, resolve } = PromiseWithResolvers(), prevDrain = stream[kDrain];
  return stream[kDrain] = () => {
    stream[kDrain] = prevDrain, resolve();
  }, promise;
async function writeBatchWithDrain(handle, stream, batch) {
  if (getQuicStreamState(stream).writeDesiredSize === 0) {
    if (await waitForDrain(stream), stream.destroyed)
      return !0;
  if (handle.write(batch) === @undefined) {
    if (!stream.destroyed)
      stream.destroy(@makeErrorWithCode(129, "Stream write failed"));
    return !0;
  return !1;
async function consumeAsyncSource(handle, stream, source) {
  handle.initStreamingSource(), initStreamingBackpressure(stream);
  try {
    let normalized = streamFrom(source);
    for await (let batch of normalized) {
      if (stream.destroyed)
        return;
      if (await writeBatchWithDrain(handle, stream, batch))
        return;
    }
    handle.endWrite();
  } catch (err) {
    if (!stream.destroyed)
      stream.destroy(err);
    else
      throw err;
async function consumeSyncSource(handle, stream, source) {
  handle.initStreamingSource(), initStreamingBackpressure(stream);
  let iter = streamFromSync(source)[SymbolIterator]();
  try {
    while (!0) {
      if (stream.destroyed)
        return;
      let { value: batch, done } = iter.next();
      if (done)
        break;
      if (await writeBatchWithDrain(handle, stream, batch))
        return;
    }
    handle.endWrite();
  } catch (err) {
    if (!stream.destroyed)
      stream.destroy(err);
    else
      throw err;
function isAsyncIterable(obj) {
  return obj != null && typeof obj[SymbolAsyncIterator] === "function";
function isSyncIterable(obj) {
  return obj != null && typeof obj[SymbolIterator] === "function";

function maybeGetCloseError(context, status, pendingError) {
  switch (context) {
    case kCloseContextClose:
      return pendingError;
    case kCloseContextBindFailure:
      return ERR_QUIC_ENDPOINT_CLOSED("Bind failure", status);
    case kCloseContextListenFailure:
      return ERR_QUIC_ENDPOINT_CLOSED("Listen failure", status);
    case kCloseContextReceiveFailure:
      return ERR_QUIC_ENDPOINT_CLOSED("Receive failure", status);
    case kCloseContextSendFailure:
      return ERR_QUIC_ENDPOINT_CLOSED("Send failure", status);
    case kCloseContextStartFailure:
      return ERR_QUIC_ENDPOINT_CLOSED("Start failure", status);

    }

    }
    function endSync() {
      if (errored)

      if (closed)
        return totalBytesWritten;

    }
    async function end(options = kEmptyObject) {

      } finally {

      }

    }
    function fail(reason) {

      },

      [drainableProtocol]() {

          return drainWakeup.promise;

      },
      [SymbolAsyncDispose]() {

      },
      [SymbolDispose]() {
        if (!closed && !errored)
          fail();
      }
    };
    if (!handle || this.destroyed || inner.state.writeEnded || inner.direction === kStreamDirectionUnidirectional && !inner.isLocal)
      return closed = !0, inner.writer = writer;
    return handle.initStreamingSource(), initStreamingBackpressure(this), inner.writer = writer;
  setBody(body) {
    if (assertIsQuicStream(this), this.destroyed)
      throw @makeErrorWithCode(129, "Stream is destroyed");
    let inner = this.#inner;
    if (inner.outboundSet)
      throw @makeErrorWithCode(129, "Stream outbound already configured");

      inner.fileHandle = body;

  [kAttachFileHandle](fh) {
    this.#inner.fileHandle = fh;
  stopSending(code = 0n) {
    if (assertIsQuicStream(this), this.destroyed)
      return;
    this.#handle.stopSending(BigInt(code));
  resetStream(code = 0n) {

  [kFinishClose](errorType, code, reason, errorName) {
    if (code === 0n) {
      debug("finishing closing the session with no error"), this.destroy();
      return;
    }
    if (debug("finishing closing the session with an error", errorType, code, reason, errorName), this.#inner.selfInitiatedClose) {
      this.destroy();
      return;
    }
    switch (errorType) {
      case 0:
        this.destroy(makeQuicError("ERR_QUIC_TRANSPORT_ERROR", "QUIC transport error", "transport", code, reason, errorName));
        break;
      case 1:
        this.destroy(makeQuicError("ERR_QUIC_APPLICATION_ERROR", "QUIC application error", "application", code, reason, errorName));
        break;
      case 2:
        this.destroy(ERR_QUIC_VERSION_NEGOTIATION_ERROR());
        break;
      case 3:
        this.destroy();
        break;
      default:
        this.destroy(makeQuicError("ERR_QUIC_TRANSPORT_ERROR", "QUIC transport error", "transport", code, reason, errorName));

function alpnWantsHttp(alpn) {

function findSuitableEndpoint(wantHttp) {
  for (let endpoint of endpointRegistry)
    if (!endpoint.destroyed && !endpoint.closing && !endpoint.busy) {
      let mode = endpoint[kClientHttp];
      if (mode !== @undefined && mode !== wantHttp)
        continue;
      if (endpoint.listening)
        continue;
      return endpoint;
    }
  return @undefined;
function processEndpointOption(endpoint, reuseEndpoint = !0, forServer = !1, wantHttp = !0) {
  if (isQuicEndpoint(endpoint))
    return endpoint;
  if (endpoint !== @undefined)
    return new QuicEndpoint(endpoint);
  if (reuseEndpoint && !forServer) {
    let existing = findSuitableEndpoint(wantHttp);
    if (existing !== @undefined)
      return existing;
  return new QuicEndpoint;
function processIdentityOptions(identity, label) {
  let { keys, certs, verifyPrivateKey = !1 } = identity;
  if (certs !== @undefined) {

function isRecoverableError(e, code) {

    return !0;

    nextToken() {

        recoverable = !0;
    }
    raise(pos, message) {
      switch (message) {
        case "Unterminated template":

          recoverable = !0;
          break;

    }

function setupReverseSearch(repl) {
  if (process.env.TERM === "dumb")
    return {
      reverseSearch() {
        return !1;
      }
    };
  let alreadyMatched = new SafeSet, labels = {
    r: "bck-i-search: ",
    s: "fwd-i-search: "
  }, isInReverseSearch = !1, historyIndex = -1, input = "", cursor = -1, dir = "r", lastMatch = -1, lastCursor = -1, promptPos;
  function checkAndSetDirectionKey(keyName) {
    if (!labels[keyName])
      return !1;
    if (dir !== keyName)
      alreadyMatched.clear(), dir = keyName;
    return !0;
  function goToNextHistoryIndex() {
    alreadyMatched.add(repl.history[historyIndex]), historyIndex += dir === "r" ? 1 : -1, cursor = -1;
  function search() {
    if (input === "") {
      print(repl.line, `${labels[dir]}_`);
      return;
    }
    if (dir === "r") {
      if (historyIndex < 0)
        historyIndex = 0;
    } else if (historyIndex >= repl.history.length)
      historyIndex = repl.history.length - 1;
    while (historyIndex >= 0 && historyIndex < repl.history.length) {
      let entry = repl.history[historyIndex];
      if (alreadyMatched.has(entry)) {
        historyIndex += dir === "r" ? 1 : -1;
        continue;
      }
      if (dir === "r") {
        if (cursor === -1)
          cursor = entry.length;
        cursor = StringPrototypeLastIndexOf(entry, input, cursor - 1);
      } else
        cursor = StringPrototypeIndexOf(entry, input, cursor + 1);
      if (cursor === -1)
        goToNextHistoryIndex();
      else {
        if (repl.useColors) {
          let start = StringPrototypeSlice(entry, 0, cursor), end = StringPrototypeSlice(entry, cursor + input.length);
          entry = `${start}\x1B[4m${input}\x1B[24m${end}`;
        }
        if (print(entry, `${labels[dir]}${input}_`, cursor), lastMatch = historyIndex, lastCursor = cursor, dir === "r" && cursor === 0 || dir === "s" && entry.length === cursor + input.length)
          goToNextHistoryIndex();
        return;
      }
    }
    print(repl.line, `failed-${labels[dir]}${input}_`);
  function print(outputLine, inputLine, cursor = repl.cursor) {
    let rows = 0;
    if (lastMatch !== -1) {
      let line = StringPrototypeSlice(repl.history[lastMatch], 0, lastCursor);
      rows = repl._getDisplayPos(`${repl.getPrompt()}${line}`).rows, cursorTo(repl.output, promptPos.cols);
    } else if (isInReverseSearch && repl.line !== "")
      rows = repl.getCursorPos().rows, cursorTo(repl.output, promptPos.cols);
    if (rows !== 0)
      moveCursor(repl.output, 0, -rows);
    if (isInReverseSearch)
      clearScreenDown(repl.output), repl.output.write(`${outputLine}
${inputLine}`);
    else
      repl.output.write(`
${inputLine}`);
    lastMatch = -1;
    let prompt = repl.getPrompt(), cursorLine = prompt + StringPrototypeSlice(outputLine, 0, cursor), cursorPos = repl._getDisplayPos(cursorLine), outputPos = repl._getDisplayPos(`${prompt}${outputLine}`), inputPos = repl._getDisplayPos(inputLine);
    rows = -1 - (inputPos.rows - (inputPos.cols === 0 ? 1 : 0)) - (outputPos.rows - cursorPos.rows), moveCursor(repl.output, 0, rows), cursorTo(repl.output, cursorPos.cols);
  function reset(string) {
    if (isInReverseSearch = string !== @undefined, !isInReverseSearch) {
      if (lastMatch !== -1)
        repl[kSetLine](repl.history[lastMatch]), repl.cursor = lastCursor, repl.historyIndex = lastMatch;
      if (lastMatch = -1, cursorTo(repl.output, promptPos.cols), moveCursor(repl.output, 0, promptPos.rows), clearScreenDown(repl.output), repl.line !== "") {
        if (repl.output.write(repl.line), repl.line.length !== repl.cursor) {
          let { cols, rows } = repl.getCursorPos();
          cursorTo(repl.output, cols), moveCursor(repl.output, 0, rows);
        }
      }
    }
    input = string || "", cursor = -1, historyIndex = repl.historyIndex, alreadyMatched.clear();
  function reverseSearch(string, key) {
    if (!isInReverseSearch) {
      if (key.ctrl && checkAndSetDirectionKey(key.name))
        historyIndex = repl.historyIndex, promptPos = repl._getDisplayPos(`${repl.getPrompt()}`), print(repl.line, `${labels[dir]}_`), isInReverseSearch = !0;
    } else if (key.ctrl && checkAndSetDirectionKey(key.name))
      search();
    else if (key.name === "backspace" || key.ctrl && (key.name === "h" || key.name === "w"))
      reset(StringPrototypeSlice(input, 0, input.length - 1)), search();
    else if (key.ctrl && key.name === "c" || key.name === "escape")
      return lastMatch = -1, reset(), !0;
    else if (key.ctrl || key.meta || key.name === "return" || key.name === "enter" || typeof string !== "string" || string === "")
      reset(), repl[kSubstringSearch] = "";
    else
      reset(`${input}${string}`), search();
    return isInReverseSearch;
  return { reverseSearch };

function findExpressionCompleteTarget(code) {
  if (!code)
    return null;
  if (code.at(-1) === ".") {
    if (code.at(-2) === "?") {
      let result = findExpressionCompleteTarget(code.slice(0, -2));
      return !result ? result : `${result}?.`;
    }
    let result = findExpressionCompleteTarget(code.slice(0, -1));
    return !result ? result : `${result}.`;
  let ast;
  try {
    ast = acorn.parse(code, { __proto__: null, sourceType: "module", ecmaVersion: "latest" });
  } catch {
    let keywords = code.split(" ");
    if (keywords.length > 1)
      return findExpressionCompleteTarget(keywords.at(-1));
    return null;
  let lastBodyStatement = ast.body[ast.body.length - 1];
  if (!lastBodyStatement)
    return null;
  if (lastBodyStatement.type === "BlockStatement")
    return null;
  if (lastBodyStatement.type === "ExpressionStatement" && lastBodyStatement.expression.right) {
    let exprRight = lastBodyStatement.expression.right, exprRightCode = code.slice(exprRight.start, exprRight.end);
    return findExpressionCompleteTarget(exprRightCode);
  if (lastBodyStatement.type === "VariableDeclaration") {
    let lastDeclarationInit = lastBodyStatement.declarations.at(-1).init;
    if (!lastDeclarationInit)
      return null;
    let lastDeclarationInitCode = code.slice(lastDeclarationInit.start, lastDeclarationInit.end);
    return findExpressionCompleteTarget(lastDeclarationInitCode);
  if (lastBodyStatement.type === "ExpressionStatement" && lastBodyStatement.expression.type === "UnaryExpression" && lastBodyStatement.expression.argument) {
    let argument = lastBodyStatement.expression.argument, argumentCode = code.slice(argument.start, argument.end);
    return findExpressionCompleteTarget(argumentCode);
  if (lastBodyStatement.type === "ExpressionStatement" && lastBodyStatement.expression.type === "NewExpression" && lastBodyStatement.expression.callee) {
    let callee = lastBodyStatement.expression.callee, calleeCode = code.slice(callee.start, callee.end);
    return findExpressionCompleteTarget(calleeCode);
  let isAllowed = !0, disallow = () => isAllowed = !1;
  if (acornWalk.simple(lastBodyStatement, {
    ForInStatement: disallow,
    ForOfStatement: disallow,
    CallExpression: disallow,
    AssignmentExpression: disallow,
    UpdateExpression: disallow
  }), !isAllowed)
    return null;
  return code.slice(lastBodyStatement.start, lastBodyStatement.end);
function includesProxiesOrGetters(expr, exprStr, evalFn, ctx, callback) {
  if (expr?.type !== "MemberExpression")
    return callback(!1);
  if (expr.object.type === "MemberExpression")
    return includesProxiesOrGetters(expr.object, exprStr.slice(0, expr.object.end), evalFn, ctx, (includes, lastEvaledObj) => {
      if (includes)
        return callback(includes);
      if (isProxy(lastEvaledObj))
        return callback(!0);
      return hasGetterOrIsProxy(lastEvaledObj, expr.property, (doesHaveGetterOrIsProxy) => callback(doesHaveGetterOrIsProxy));
    });
  if (expr.object.type === "Identifier")
    return evalFn(`try { ${expr.object.name} } catch {}`, ctx, getREPLResourceName(), (err, obj) => {
      if (err)
        return callback(!1);
      if (isProxy(obj))
        return callback(!0);
      return hasGetterOrIsProxy(obj, expr.property, (doesHaveGetterOrIsProxy) => {
        if (doesHaveGetterOrIsProxy)
          return callback(!0);
        return evalFn(`try { ${exprStr} } catch {} `, ctx, getREPLResourceName(), (err, obj) => {
          if (err)
            return callback(!1);
          return callback(!1, obj);
        });
      });
    });
  function hasGetterOrIsProxy(obj, astProp, cb) {
    if (!obj || !astProp)
      return cb(!1);
    if (astProp.type === "Literal")
      return propHasGetterOrIsProxy(obj, astProp.value, cb);
    if (astProp.type === "Identifier" && exprStr.at(astProp.start - 1) === ".")
      return propHasGetterOrIsProxy(obj, astProp.name, cb);
    return evalFn(`try { ${exprStr.slice(astProp.start, astProp.end)} } catch {} `, ctx, getREPLResourceName(), (err, evaledProp) => {
      if (err)
        return cb(!1);
      if (typeof evaledProp === "string")
        return propHasGetterOrIsProxy(obj, evaledProp, cb);
      return cb(!1);
    });
  return callback(!1);
function propHasGetterOrIsProxy(obj, prop, cb) {
  if (typeof ObjectGetOwnPropertyDescriptor(obj, prop)?.get === "function")
    return cb(!0);
  if (isProxy(obj[prop]))
    return cb(!0);
  return cb(!1);

function makeZlibTransform(createHandleFn, processFlag, finishFlag) {
  return {
    __proto__: null,
    [kValidatedTransform]: !0,
    transform: async function* (source, options) {
      let { signal } = options;
      signal?.throwIfAborted();
      let outBuf, outOffset = 0, chunkSize, pending = [], pendingBytes = 0, resolveWrite, rejectWrite, writeInput, writeFlush, writeInOff, writeAvailIn, writeAvailOutBefore;
      function onWriteComplete() {
        let availOut = writeState[0], availInAfter = writeState[1], have = writeAvailOutBefore - availOut, bufferExhausted = availOut === 0 || outOffset + have >= chunkSize;
        if (have > 0) {
          if (bufferExhausted && outOffset === 0)
            pending.push(outBuf);
          else if (bufferExhausted)
            pending.push(outBuf.subarray(outOffset, outOffset + have));
          else
            pending.push(Uint8ArraySlice.@call(outBuf, outOffset, outOffset + have));
          pendingBytes += have, outOffset += have;
        }
        if (bufferExhausted)
          outBuf = Buffer.allocUnsafe(chunkSize), outOffset = 0;
        if (availOut === 0) {
          if (!resolveWrite)
            return;
          let consumed = writeAvailIn - availInAfter;
          writeInOff += consumed, writeAvailIn = availInAfter, writeAvailOutBefore = chunkSize - outOffset, handle.write(writeFlush, writeInput, writeInOff, writeAvailIn, outBuf, outOffset, writeAvailOutBefore);
          return;
        }
        handle.buffer = null;
        let resolve = resolveWrite;
        if (resolveWrite = @undefined, rejectWrite = @undefined, resolve)
          resolve();
      }
      function onError(message, errno, code) {
        let error = genericNodeError(message, { __proto__: null, errno, code });
        error.errno = errno, error.code = code;
        let reject = rejectWrite;
        if (resolveWrite = @undefined, rejectWrite = @undefined, reject)
          reject(error);
      }
      let result = createHandleFn(onWriteComplete, onError), { handle, writeState } = result;
      chunkSize = result.chunkSize, outBuf = Buffer.allocUnsafe(chunkSize);
      let onAbort = () => {
        let reject = rejectWrite;
        if (resolveWrite = @undefined, rejectWrite = @undefined, reject)
          reject(signal.reason ?? @makeAbortError());
      };
      signal.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { __proto__: null, once: !0 });
      function processInputAsync(input, flushFlag) {
        let { promise, resolve, reject } = @Promise.withResolvers();
        return resolveWrite = resolve, rejectWrite = reject, writeInput = input, writeFlush = flushFlag, writeInOff = 0, writeAvailIn = input.byteLength, writeAvailOutBefore = chunkSize - outOffset, handle.buffer = input, handle.write(flushFlag, input, 0, writeAvailIn, outBuf, outOffset, writeAvailOutBefore), promise;
      }
      function drainBatch() {
        if (pendingBytes <= BATCH_HWM) {
          let batch = pending;
          return pending = [], pendingBytes = 0, batch;
        }
        let batch = [], batchBytes = 0;
        while (pending.length > 0 && batchBytes < BATCH_HWM) {
          let buf = pending.shift();
          batch.push(buf);
          let len = buf.byteLength;
          batchBytes += len, pendingBytes -= len;
        }
        return batch;
      }
      let finalized = !1, iter = source[Symbol.asyncIterator]();
      try {
        let nextResult = iter.next();
        while (!0) {
          let { value: chunks, done } = await nextResult;
          if (done)
            break;
          if (signal?.throwIfAborted(), chunks === null) {
            if (!finalized) {
              finalized = !0, await processInputAsync(kEmpty, finishFlag);
              while (pending.length > 0)
                yield drainBatch();
            }
            nextResult = iter.next();
            continue;
          }
          nextResult = iter.next();
          for (let i = 0;i < chunks.length; i++)
            await processInputAsync(chunks[i], processFlag);
          if (pendingBytes >= BATCH_HWM)
            while (pending.length > 0 && pendingBytes >= BATCH_HWM)
              yield drainBatch();
          if (pending.length > 0)
            yield drainBatch();
        }
        if (!finalized && !signal.aborted) {
          finalized = !0, await processInputAsync(kEmpty, finishFlag);
          while (pending.length > 0)
            yield drainBatch();
        }
      } finally {
        signal.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort), handle.close();
        try {
          await iter.return?.();
        } catch {}
      }
    }

function makeZlibTransformSync(createHandleFn, processFlag, finishFlag) {
  return {
    __proto__: null,
    transform: function* (source) {
      let error = null;
      function onError(message, errno, code) {
        error = genericNodeError(message, { __proto__: null, errno, code }), error.errno = errno, error.code = code;
      }
      let result = createHandleFn(() => {}, onError), { handle, writeState, chunkSize } = result, outBuf = Buffer.allocUnsafe(chunkSize), outOffset = 0, pending = [], pendingBytes = 0;
      function processSyncInput(input, flushFlag) {
        let inOff = 0, availIn = input.byteLength, availOutBefore = chunkSize - outOffset;
        if (handle.writeSync(flushFlag, input, inOff, availIn, outBuf, outOffset, availOutBefore), error)
          throw error;
        while (!0) {
          let availOut = writeState[0], availInAfter = writeState[1], have = availOutBefore - availOut, bufferExhausted = availOut === 0 || outOffset + have >= chunkSize;
          if (have > 0) {
            if (bufferExhausted && outOffset === 0)
              pending.push(outBuf);
            else if (bufferExhausted)
              pending.push(outBuf.subarray(outOffset, outOffset + have));
            else
              pending.push(Uint8ArraySlice.@call(outBuf, outOffset, outOffset + have));
            pendingBytes += have, outOffset += have;
          }
          if (bufferExhausted)
            outBuf = Buffer.allocUnsafe(chunkSize), outOffset = 0;
          if (availOut === 0) {
            let consumed = availIn - availInAfter;
            if (inOff += consumed, availIn = availInAfter, availOutBefore = chunkSize - outOffset, handle.writeSync(flushFlag, input, inOff, availIn, outBuf, outOffset, availOutBefore), error)
              throw error;
            continue;
          }
          break;
        }
      }
      function drainBatch() {
        if (pendingBytes <= BATCH_HWM) {
          let batch = pending;
          return pending = [], pendingBytes = 0, batch;
        }
        let batch = [], batchBytes = 0;
        while (pending.length > 0 && batchBytes < BATCH_HWM) {
          let buf = pending.shift(), len = buf.byteLength;
          batch.push(buf), batchBytes += len, pendingBytes -= len;
        }
        return batch;
      }
      try {
        for (let batch of source) {
          if (batch === null) {
            processSyncInput(Buffer.alloc(0), finishFlag);
            while (pending.length > 0)
              yield drainBatch();
            continue;
          }
          for (let i = 0;i < batch.length; i++)
            processSyncInput(batch[i], processFlag);
          if (pendingBytes >= BATCH_HWM)
            while (pending.length > 0 && pendingBytes >= BATCH_HWM)
              yield drainBatch();
          if (pending.length > 0)
            yield drainBatch();
        }
      } finally {
        handle.close();
      }
    }
  };

function getCIDR(address, netmask, family) {

      if (i + 1 < netmask.length)
        continue;
      i++;
    }
    let part = netmask.slice(lastPos, i);
    if (lastPos = i + 1, part !== "")
      if (hasZeros) {

          return null;

            return null;
          hasZeros = !0;
        }
      }
  return `${address}/${ones}`;

  if (headers[HTTP2_HEADER_METHOD] === "CONNECT") {
    if (!server.emit("connect", request, response))
      response.statusCode = HTTP_STATUS_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED, response.end();
    return;
  if (headers.expect !== @undefined) {
    if (headers.expect === "100-continue")
      if (server.listenerCount("checkContinue"))
        server.emit("checkContinue", request, response);
      else
        response.writeContinue(), server.emit("request", request, response);
    else if (server.listenerCount("checkExpectation"))
      server.emit("checkExpectation", request, response);
    else
      response.statusCode = HTTP_STATUS_EXPECTATION_FAILED, response.end();
    return;
  server.emit("request", request, response);

function receivedValueLabel(value) {
  if (value === null)
    return "null";
  if (typeof value === "object")
    return "an instance of " + (value.constructor?.name || "Object");

    return `type string ('${value}')`;
  if (typeof value === "symbol")
    return `type symbol (${@String(value)})`;
  if (typeof value === "number")
    return `type number (${@String(value)})`;

    case "number":

      };

    case "undefined":

    case "bigint":
      return {
        type: "bigint",
        unserializableValue: `${arg}n`,
        description: `${arg}n`

    case "symbol":
      return { type: "symbol", description: @String(arg) };
    case "function":
      return {
        type: "function",
        description: Function.prototype.toString.@call(arg)
      };
    default:
      if (arg === null)

    for (let block of blocks) {

      while (stack.length > 0 && functions[stack[stack.length - 1]][1] < block[0])
        stack.pop();

function subprotocolParse(header) {

sessions_interrupted_total
Session child processes spawned over the runner's lifetime. One increment per child spawn; a session that is re-spawned (runner restart, re-assignment) counts again. NOT comparable to the orchestrator's spawn_hooks_total (which counts orchestrator spawn-runner hook runs, including warm hints).
Session child processes that ended cleanly over the runner's lifetime: child exited 0, the server closed the session (archive/delete), or the runner released the slot as a clean handoff (idle release, startup timeout, retire / max-session-age release, server deassign). Drain/SIGTERM and the max-lifetime hard-cap kill are NOT counted (those increment sessions_interrupted_total instead).&
Session child processes that exited with a non-zero code over the runner's lifetime (crash, OOM, spawn error). Does NOT include idle-release or a server deassign the poll loop observed first (those count as completed); a deassign the child notices first via its epoch-409 exit still lands here.
Session child processes that were terminated for a non-session-outcome reason over its lifetime (drain/SIGTERM, max-lifetime hard-cap kill, released=false backstop, or an external signal). Watchdog and external-signal kills are additionally reported to the server as session failures. Closes the accounting: started - (completed + failed + interrupted) equals the number of session children currently running.

#!/bin/sh
common_dir=$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) || common_dir=.git
local_hook="$common_dir/hooks/$(basename "$0")"
[ -x "$local_hook" ] && exec "$local_hook" "$@"
exit 0
#!/bin/sh
common_dir=$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) || common_dir=.git
local_hook="$common_dir/hooks/$(basename "$0")"
if [ -x "$local_hook" ]; then
  "$local_hook" "$@" || exit $?
email="$CCR_SESSION_ACCOUNT_EMAIL"
nl='
case "$email" in
  ''|*'<'*|*'>'*|*"$nl"*) email='' ;;
esac
if [ -n "$email" ] && printf %s "$email" | LC_ALL=C grep -q '[^ -~]'; then
  email=''
if [ -n "$email" ]; then
  name="${email%%@*}"
  git interpret-trailers --in-place \
    --if-exists addIfDifferent \
    --trailer "Co-authored-by: $name <$email>" "$1"
exit 0

# Claude Code agent proxy
Outbound HTTPS from this session goes through a local proxy at 
(set via HTTPS_PROXY) which tunnels to a policy-enforcing egress proxy. TLS is
re-terminated there, so every tool must trust the CA bundle at
. The standard CA environment variables, the system trust
store (where possible), a JVM truststore, the Bazel system bazelrc, the
browser NSS store, and gsutil's boto config are already set up.
## Quick diagnosis
1. Run: curl -sS 
  (examples: --cacert, SSL_CERT_FILE, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE,
  AWS_CA_BUNDLE, DENO_CERT, CARGO_HTTP_CAINFO, PIP_CERT, GIT_SSL_CAINFO,
  BUNDLE_SSL_CA_CERT, HEX_CACERTS_PATH, NIX_SSL_CERT_FILE).
- Tool config files override environment variables. If one of these sets its
  own CA or disables verification, point it at the bundle instead:
  pip.conf "cert", npm "cafile" (npm config get cafile), ~/.curlrc "cacert",
  .wgetrc "ca_certificate", conda "ssl_verify", git "http.sslCAInfo",
  gradle.properties / MAVEN_OPTS "-Djavax.net.ssl.trustStore".
- JVM tools (Maven, Gradle, plain Java): when a JDK is present,
  JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS points JVMs at a truststore that holds the proxy CA: the
  JDK's own store if the system trust install already added the CA there,
  otherwise 
 and do not trust
the CA. Workarounds: run builds with --network host, copy 
into the build context and install it in an early layer, and pass proxy/CA
settings explicitly to the build.
### Not supported through the proxy (report, do not work around)
gRPC / HTTP/2-only APIs, WebSocket upgrades, client-mTLS, certificate-pinned
clients (e.g. Snowflake, ngrok), non-443 HTTPS ports, raw-TCP databases.
If a tool still cannot work through the proxy, report it to your
administrator or Anthropic support so the policy or tooling can be fixed.

#!/bin/sh
# claude agent-proxy governed-git gh shim (auto-generated; per-session).
# Routes gh-to-github.com through the session relay ONLY when the
# invocation carries no customer credential. GHE targets (GH_HOST,
# --hostname, a -R/--repo/GH_REPO naming a non-github.com host, or a
# non-github.com origin remote in the cwd checkout) and
# real-customer-token invocations exec directly on the
# customer's own egress, so customer credentials never transit the
# relay tunnel and gh-to-GHE keeps working.
# Real customer tokens decide alone, checked first (costs nothing):
# gh sends GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN proactively, and the GHE-scoped
# enterprise pair means gh may target a GHE host in ways the checks
# them through the tunnel.
# NO_PROXY cleared: an ambient runner-host NO_PROXY covering
# github.com would make gh skip the relay and send the literal dummy
# token to the real GitHub API (hard 401).
HTTPS_PROXY='
' https_proxy='
NO_PROXY='' no_proxy='' \
SSL_CERT_FILE='
GH_TOKEN='
' GITHUB_TOKEN='
exec '
' "$@"
